name: A fall at home
prompt: An old woman fell in her bathroom last night and has lain there since. She says she's fine and doesn't want to go.

choices.text: Sit with her and explain what a night on the floor does

outcome.told: It takes half an hour. She lets you take her in, holding her own bag.

choices.text: Have her sign the refusal and clear the call

outcome.told: She signs. Her daughter calls the next day to say she's doing well.

failure.told: You're sent back to the same house two days later. This time she can't speak, and your name is on the first report.
